verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਕਮਾਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਇਆ ਹੋਇ ਉਪੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: jiau visamaadh kamaadh hai sir talavaiaa hoi upa(n)naa|

en.bdb: Nature of sugarcane is wondrous: it takes birth head down.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਖਲ ਉਖਲਿਕੈ ਟੋਟੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਭੰਨਣਿ ਭੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: pahile khal ukhalikai ToTe kar kar bha(n)nan bha(n)naa|

en.bdb: First its skin is eeled off and it is cut into pieces.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਲੂ ਪਾਇ ਪੀੜਾਇਆ ਰਸ ਟਟਰਿ ਕਸ ਇੰਨਣ ਵੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: koloo pai peeRaiaa ras TaTar kas i(n)nan va(n)naa|

en.bdb: Then it is crushed in cane crusher; its nice is boiled in a cauldren and the bagasse is burnt as fuel.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਬਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਇ ਅਵਟਣੁ ਜਗ ਧੰਨ ਧੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhukh sukh a(n)dhar sabar kar khai avaTan jag dha(n)n dha(n)naa|

en.bdb: It remains ontented in joys and sufferings alike and after getting boiled is called est in the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁੜੁ ਸਕਰੁ ਖੰਡੁ ਮਿਸਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਭ ਰਸ ਬੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: guR sakar kha(n)dd misaree gurmukh sukh fal sabh ras ba(n)naa|

en.bdb: Attaining the pleasure fruit, like gurmukh, it becomes he base of jaggery, sugar and crystal sugar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪੀਵਣਾ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਥੀਵਣੁ ਗੰਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: piram piaalaa peevanaa mar mar jeevan theevan ga(n)naa|

en.bdb: Death after quaffing the cup f love is similar to the life of sugarcane which after getting crushed becomes live.
Sayings of gurmukhs are invaluable like jewels.
